biography.value: Gladiators battle for the entertainment of raucous crowds. Some gladiators are brutal pit fighters who treat each match as a life-or-death struggle, while others are professional duelists who command huge fees but rarely fight to the death.

description.value: The gladiator makes three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+7]]{+7} to hit, reach 5 ft. and range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 ([[/damage 2d6 + 4 type=piercing]]) damage, or 13 ([[/damage 2d8 + 4 type=piercing]]) damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

Melee Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+7]]{+7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 ([[/damage 2d4 + 4 type=bludgeoning]]) damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a [[/save ability=str dc=15]] saving throw or be knocked &Reference[condition=prone].
The gladiator has advantage on saving throws against being &Reference[condition=frightened].
A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the gladiator hits with it (included in the attack).
The gladiator adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the gladiator must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
Made from tough but flexible leather, studded leather is reinforced with close-set rivets or spikes.
A shield is made from wood or metal and is carried in one hand. Wielding a shield increases your Armor Class by 2. You can benefit from only one shield at a time.
